articles.title: Kimsuky Uses Fake Zoom Installers and Malicious LNK Files to Deploy Malware
articles.summary:

articles.title: Critical GitLab Vulnerability Allows Unauthenticated Attackers to Execute Remote Code
articles.summary:

This vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-97229, has been assigned the highest CVSS score of 10.0 and impacts both GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition.
